Issues are the place where changes are discussed in this project: external pull
requests are not being merged yet (`CONTRIBUTING.md`). Please do not include
secrets, credentials, or personal data.

## Problem

What is missing or awkward today, and who runs into it. Link to the relevant
file, document, or test if you can.

## Proposed change

What you would like to see instead. Describe the smallest version that would
help; alternatives you considered are welcome.

## Honesty check

- [ ] The proposal does not add PyTorch, TensorFlow, ML.NET training, or any
      equivalent external ML framework. Every algorithm here is implemented from
      scratch (project Rule 10, see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).

## Anything else

Notes, references, or prior art.
